key_features: MODERNIZED DESIGN — Experience the modernized design of the XBOX Wireless Controller with sculpted surfaces and updated geometry that enhances comfort and control during long gaming sessions.
PRECISION PERFORMANCE — Stay on target with a hybrid D-pad and textured grips on triggers, bumpers, and back case for improved accuracy and handling.
SHARE BUTTON: Seamlessly capture and share content such as screenshots, recordings, and more with the new Share button.
VERSATILE CONNECTIVITY — Connect via USB-C for plug-and-play on console and PC, or quickly pair and switch between supported devices with XBOX Wireless and Bluetooth support.
BUILT-IN AUDIO SUPPORT — Plug in compatible headsets using the 3.5mm audio jack for direct voice chat and immersive in-game sound.
CUSTOM CONTROLS — Use the XBOX Accessories app to remap buttons and create personalized controller profiles tailored to your favorite games and playstyle.
review_summary: Built for Long Sessions, Ready for Every Screen Whether you're deep into a weekend session or picking up for a quick match, the XBOX Wireless Controller in Pulse Red is built to keep up. Its sculpted surfaces and refined geometry are designed around how you actually hold a controller, delivering comfort that lasts through up to 40 hours of battery life on standard AA batteries.* One Controller. Every Device You Play On. Pair wirelessly to your console, then switch to your Windows PC or stream games across mobile, gaming handhelds, Smart TVs, and supported VR headsets with XBOX Cloud Gaming.** One controller, every screen you play on. Includes XBOX Wireless and Bluetooth® technology for seamless wireless connectivity across devices.* Make It Yours Customize your experience with the XBOX Accessories app. Remap buttons, build custom profiles for different games, and switch between them on the fly.* Important Info*Compatible with select devices and operating system versions; learn more at xbox.com/controller-compatibility. Use with controller compatible games. Battery life varies significantly with headsets, additional accessories, usage, and other factors. Testing conducted by Microsoft using standard AA batteries in preproduction units. Button mapping available via XBOX Accessories app for XBOX Series X|S, XBOX One, and Windows 10/11; app for Windows 10/11 requires compatible USB-C cable sold separately.**XBOX Cloud Gaming requires Game Pass subscription and supported device both sold separately. Cloud playable games not included with Game Pass are sold separately and may be made available with Game Pass in the future. Game catalog varies.
